Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
High Aye says:
"If the action succeeds, you may discard up to two cards from your hand
(draw afterward)."

What is the timing of this discard?
Specifically, 3 questions:

1) If I bleed successfully with a High Aye, can I discard 2 cards,
replace them, and then play (superior) Spying Mission?

2) If I Bum's Rush successfully with a High Aye, do I discard cards:
a) Before the combat?
b) After the combat?
c) During the combat?
d) I may choose one of the above, but must do all the discards at once.
e) I may "split" my 2 discards between any of the above.

3) If I perform a successful Political Action with a High Aye, do I
discard cards:
a) Before the referendum?
b) After the referendum?
c) During the referendum?
d) I may choose one of the above, but must do all the discards at once.
e) I may "split" my 2 discards between any of the above.

I think this covers all possibilities. ("e" is unlikely, but I thought
I'd throw it in there)

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> High Aye says:
> "If the action succeeds, you may discard up to two cards from your hand
> (draw afterward)."
>
> What is the timing of this discard?

After resolving the action. Like Freak Drive's window.

> Specifically, 3 questions:
>
> 1) If I bleed successfully with a High Aye, can I discard 2 cards,
> replace them, and then play (superior) Spying Mission?

No.

If you drew a Freak Drive, though, you could play it.

> 2) If I Bum's Rush successfully with a High Aye, do I discard cards:
> a) Before the combat?
> b) After the combat?
> c) During the combat?
> d) I may choose one of the above, but must do all the discards at once.
> e) I may "split" my 2 discards between any of the above.

b) (including after all subsequent combats -- Psyche!, etc.)

And also "before replacing the Bum's Rush".

> 3) If I perform a successful Political Action with a High Aye, do I
> discard cards:
> a) Before the referendum?
> b) After the referendum?
> c) During the referendum?
> d) I may choose one of the above, but must do all the discards at once.
> e) I may "split" my 2 discards between any of the above.

b)
